name: '1159.4/2 Original Widget Style + Share Every Data Point + Moving Source Visuals APK'
'on':
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/RUNNINGBALL2-1159.4-2-EVERY-DATA-POINT-SHARE-REAL-VISUALS-APK.yml'
  workflow_dispatch: {}
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 120
    steps:
    - name: Checkout DUWM unchanged source
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Read original protected RUNNINGBALL2 source
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        repository: Sentongoharuna/Du-World-Situation-Room-
        ref: 7d952dd607cdeec94832896023c10203425a3b7f
        path: rb2-original-source
        persist-credentials: false
    - name: Python 3.12
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: '3.12'
    - name: Java 17
      uses: actions/setup-java@v4
      with:
        distribution: temurin
        java-version: '17'
    - name: Gradle 8.13
      uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
      with:
        gradle-version: '8.13'
        cache-disabled: true
    - name: Read verified workflow source (PyYAML)
      run: python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir PyYAML==6.0.3
    - name: Preflight unchanged 1159.4/2 version, individual sharing and real source visuals
      shell: bash
      run: |-
        set -euo pipefail
        python3 - <<'PY_115942_PREFLIGHT'
        from pathlib import Path
        import yaml,ast,base64,gzip,hashlib,re
        wf=yaml.safe_load(Path('.github/workflows/RUNNINGBALL2-1159.4-2-EVERY-DATA-POINT-SHARE-REAL-VISUALS-APK.yml').read_text())
        steps=wf['jobs']['build']['steps']
        installer=next(s['run'] for s in steps if s['name']=='Install 1159.4/2 moving source visuals and individual data sharing')
        body=re.search(r"<<'PY_DUWM_115942_INSTALL'\n(.*?)\nPY_DUWM_115942_INSTALL",installer,re.S).group(1)
        ast.parse(body)
        values={}
        node=next(n for n in ast.parse(body).body if isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id=='encoded' for t in n.targets))
        payload=ast.literal_eval(node.value)
        source=gzip.decompress(base64.b64decode(payload,validate=True))
        assert hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest()=='600e6ef19a5cd52b911051271314b6562c90a72f1f09bd8ffa6300fae865adb9'
        java=source.decode()
        for signature in ('V115941ShareCards.share','postInvalidateDelayed(33)','OpenSky Network','USGS Earthquake Hazards Program','BBC News RSS','Where The ISS At'):
         assert signature in java,signature
        assert '1159.4/2' in wf['name']
        assert any('Rebuild original 1159.4/1 app without adding any new widgets' in s['name'] for s in steps)
        assert any('Verify signed APK actual compiled DEX and correct version' == s['name'] for s in steps)
        print('PASS: immutable Android source, original widget preservation, individual sharing and source-driven visuals')
        PY_115942_PREFLIGHT
    - name: Rebuild original 1159.4/1 app without adding any new widgets
      shell: bash
      run: |-
        set -euo pipefail
        python3 - <<'PY_DUWM_BASE'
        from pathlib import Path
        import os,subprocess,tempfile,yaml
        source=Path('.github/workflows/RUNNINGBALL2-V1159.4-1-SHARE-CARDS.yml')
        assert source.is_file(), 'Verified inherited 1159.4/1 source workflow missing'
        wf=yaml.safe_load(source.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        steps=wf['jobs']['build']['steps']
        assert len(steps)>=64 and steps[6]['name'].startswith('Rebuild full V109 native app')
        assert 'V1159.4/1 INSTALL advanced branded share cards on every source record' in steps[41]['name']
        assert 'set Android version 1159.4/1' in steps[42]['name']
        assert all('run' in x and 'uses' not in x for x in steps[6:43]), 'Unexpected inherited action instead of source generation'
        workspace=Path(os.environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE']); env=os.environ.copy(); marker=Path(env['GITHUB_ENV'])
        for index in range(6,43):
            step=steps[index]; script=step['run']; title=step['name']
            assert isinstance(script,str) and len(script)<250000 and '${{' not in script, ('Unsafe/incomplete source script',title)
            print('INHERITED SOURCE STEP',index+1,title,flush=True)
            with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(prefix='duwm115942-',suffix='.sh',dir=env['RUNNER_TEMP'],mode='w',delete=False) as f:
                f.write(script); fn=Path(f.name)
            try:
                p=subprocess.run(['bash','-eo','pipefail',str(fn)],cwd=workspace,env=env,check=False)
            finally:
                fn.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            if p.returncode:raise SystemExit('Inherited source generation failed at '+title+' code '+str(p.returncode))
            if marker.exists():
                for line in marker.read_text().splitlines():
                    if '=' in line:
                        key,value=line.split('=',1)
                        if key.isidentifier():env[key]=value
        project=Path(env.get('PROJECT_DIR',''))
        assert project.is_dir() and (project/'app/build.gradle.kts').is_file(),'Original Android source generation incomplete'
        assert (project/'app/src/main/java/com/sentongoharuna/worldsituationroom/V115941ShareCards.java').is_file(),'Existing original share card renderer missing'
        with marker.open('a') as f:f.write('PROJECT_DIR='+str(project.resolve())+'\n')
        print('PASS complete genuine 1159.4/1 app baseline, protected original widgets and branded record sharing',flush=True)
        PY_DUWM_BASE
    - name: Install 1159.4/2 moving source visuals and individual data sharing

        original=gzip.decompress(base64.b64decode(encoded))
        assert hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest()=='600e6ef19a5cd52b911051271314b6562c90a72f1f09bd8ffa6300fae865adb9'
        protect=['SatelliteMapView.java','DuwmLiveWallpaperService.java','OperationsGlobeView.java','V115941ShareCards.java','MediaDeskActivity.java','AircraftOperationsActivity.java','WorldSourceHubActivity.java']
        widget_names=['DuWidgetProviders.java','DuWidgetUpdater.java','WidgetSnapshot.java','WidgetRefreshScheduler.java']
        protected={n:hashlib.sha256((pkg/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for n in protect+widget_names if (pkg/n).exists()}
        widget_resource={str(f):hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in (src/'res').rglob('*') if f.is_file() and 'widget' in f.name.lower()}
        activity=pkg/'PulseDataActivity.java';assert not activity.exists(), 'Avoid overwriting existing activity'
        activity.write_bytes(original)
        main=pkg/'OperationsMainActivity.java';text=main.read_text()
        anchor='        LinearLayout layers=new LinearLayout(this);'
        assert text.count(anchor)==1, 'Operations first-screen overlay location changed; refusing unsafe injection'
        entry='''        TextView pulseEntry=action("LIVE SIGNAL VISUALS  /  SHARE EACH RECORD",
                        "Source-observed aircraft, earthquakes, ISS and news; visual radar and point sharing");
                pulseEntry.setTextColor(Color.rgb(99,229,227));
                pulseEntry.setOnClickListener(v->startActivity(new Intent(this,PulseDataActivity.class)));
                globeFrame.addView(pulseEntry,new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1,dp(50)));
        '''
        assert 'globeFrame' in text and 'TextView shareObserved' in text, 'Base advanced cards or globe controls absent'
        text=text.replace(anchor,entry+anchor,1);main.write_text(text)
        manifest=src/'AndroidManifest.xml';ET.register_namespace('android','http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android');tree=ET.parse(manifest)
        app=tree.getroot().find('application');assert app is not None
        android='{http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android}'
        assert not any(x.get(android+'name','') in ('.PulseDataActivity','com.sentongoharuna.worldsituationroom.PulseDataActivity') for x in app.findall('activity'))
        receivers_before=[(x.tag,x.get(android+'name','')) for x in app if x.tag=='receiver']
        ET.SubElement(app,'activity',{android+'name':'.PulseDataActivity',android+'exported':'true',android+'label':'LIVE SIGNAL VISUALS'})
        assert [(x.tag,x.get(android+'name','')) for x in app if x.tag=='receiver']==receivers_before
        manifest.write_bytes(ET.tostring(tree.getroot(),encoding='utf-8',xml_declaration=True))
        # Same package and logo: new version replaces rather than duplicating the installation.
        gradle=root/'app/build.gradle.kts';g=gradle.read_text()
        g,n=re.subn(r'(?m)^(\s*versionCode\s*=\s*)115941(\s*)$',r'\g<1>115942\g<2>',g)
        assert n==1,'Expected inherited share-card versionCode 115941 missing'
        g,n=re.subn(r'(?m)^(\s*versionName\s*=\s*)"1159\.4/1"(\s*)$',r'\g<1>"1159.4/2"\g<2>',g)
        assert n==1, 'Inherited app versionName anchor missing'
        assert 'applicationId = "com.sentongoharuna.worldsituationroom.rb2live25"' in g
        assert 'versionCode = 115942' in g and 'versionName = "1159.4/2"' in g
        gradle.write_text(g)
        strings=src/'res/values/strings.xml';s=strings.read_text();s,n=re.subn('DEVELOP\.UGANDA V1159\.4/1','DEVELOP.UGANDA 1159.4/2',s,count=1)
        assert n==1,'Current app label source missing';strings.write_text(s)
        for n,h in protected.items():assert hashlib.sha256((pkg/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h,('Original protected code changed',n)
        for f,h in widget_resource.items():assert hashlib.sha256(Path(f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h,('Original widget visual resource changed',f)
        assert 'V115941ShareCards.share' in activity.read_text() and 'postInvalidateDelayed(33)' in activity.read_text()
        assert all(x in activity.read_text() for x in ('OpenSky Network','USGS Earthquake Hazards Program','BBC News RSS','Where The ISS At','SOURCE TIME UNKNOWN','NO VERIFIED RECORDS'))
        print('PASS V1159.4/2 source: interactive radar, provider-driven motion, individual shareable records, coloured signals, source-truth timeline, original widgets untouched')
        PY_DUWM_115942_INSTALL
    - name: Compile complete Android APK
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        cd "$PROJECT_DIR"
        gradle --no-daemon --no-configuration-cache :app:compileDebugJavaWithJavac :app:assembleDebug --stacktrace
        mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/release"
        cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/*.apk "$RUNNER_TEMP/release/DEVELOP-UGANDA-1159.4-2.apk"
    - name: Verify signed APK actual compiled DEX and correct version
      shell: bash
      run: |-
        set -euo pipefail
        python3 - "$PROJECT_DIR" "$RUNNER_TEMP/release/DEVELOP-UGANDA-1159.4-2.apk" <<'PY_DUWM_VERIFY'
        from pathlib import Path
        import subprocess,sys,zipfile
        project,apk=map(Path,sys.argv[1:]);assert apk.is_file() and apk.stat().st_size>150000
        with zipfile.ZipFile(apk) as z:
         assert z.testzip() is None
         files=z.namelist();assert 'classes.dex' in files and 'AndroidManifest.xml' in files
         dex=b''.join(z.read(n) for n in files if n.endswith('.dex'))
         for item in (b'PulseDataActivity',b'V115941ShareCards',b'OperationsGlobeView',b'DuWidgetProviders',b'BBC News RSS',b'SOURCE COUNT',b'WORLD GEOGRAPHIC DISPLAY',b'EARTHQUAKE'):
          assert item in dex,('New visualization/data sharing or original feature missing from compiled APK',item)
        sdk=Path(__import__('os').environ['ANDROID_HOME']);tools=sdk/'build-tools/36.0.0'
        subprocess.run([str(tools/'apksigner'),'verify',str(apk)],check=True)
        badge=subprocess.check_output([str(tools/'aapt'),'dump','badging',str(apk)],text=True)
        assert "versionCode='115942'" in badge and "1159.4/2" in badge,badge[:300]
        assert "name='com.sentongoharuna.worldsituationroom.rb2live25'" in badge
        print('PASS real signed Android APK with radar, data cards, source truth and unchanged application identity')
        PY_DUWM_VERIFY
    - name: Upload full APK even before emulator tests
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: DEVELOP-UGANDA-1159.4-2-APK
        path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release/DEVELOP-UGANDA-1159.4-2.apk
        retention-days: 30
        if-no-files-found: error
    - name: Enable emulator KVM acceleration
      shell: bash
      run: |-
        echo 'KERNEL=="kvm", GROUP="kvm", MODE="0666", OPTIONS+="static_node=kvm"' | sudo tee /etc/udev/rules.d/99-kvm4all.rules
        sudo udevadm control --reload-rules
        sudo udevadm trigger --name-match=kvm || true
    - name: Android emulator verifies genuine visual screen and per-point share action
      uses: reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2
      with:
        api-level: 34
        target: google_apis
        arch: x86_64
        profile: pixel_6
        cores: 2
        ram-size: 2048M
        disable-animations: true
        emulator-options: -no-window -gpu swiftshader_indirect -noaudio -no-boot-anim
        script: "set -euo pipefail\nadb install -r \"$RUNNER_TEMP/release/DEVELOP-UGANDA-1159.4-2.apk\"\nadb\
          \ shell am start -n com.sentongoharuna.worldsituationroom.rb2live25/com.sentongoharuna.worldsituationroom.PulseDataActivity\n\
          sleep 5\nadb shell dumpsys activity activities | grep -q 'PulseDataActivity'\nadb shell uiautomator\
          \ dump /sdcard/duwm115942.xml >/dev/null\nadb shell cat /sdcard/duwm115942.xml > \"$RUNNER_TEMP/duwm-115942-ui.xml\"\
          \ngrep -q 'LIVE SIGNAL INTELLIGENCE' \"$RUNNER_TEMP/duwm-115942-ui.xml\"\ngrep -q 'SHARE SELECTED\
          \ INDIVIDUAL DATA POINT' \"$RUNNER_TEMP/duwm-115942-ui.xml\"\nadb exec-out screencap -p > \"$RUNNER_TEMP/duwm-115942-visuals.png\"\
          \ntest -s \"$RUNNER_TEMP/duwm-115942-visuals.png\"\nif adb logcat -d -t 3000 | grep -E 'FATAL EXCEPTION.*|Process:\
          \ com.sentongoharuna.worldsituationroom.rb2live25' | tail -n 10; then true;fi\necho 'PASS Android\
          \ emulator: new source-driven radar opens and individual share controls visible' "
    - name: Upload real Android screenshot and UI evidence

        name: DEVELOP-UGANDA-1159.4-2-ANDROID-EVIDENCE
